Admission Process
All students are eligible to take free admission as per guidelines of Govt. of Assam.
Reservation of Seats
In the matter of admission reservation of the seat (Quota) will be followed as per the rules and regulations farmed by Govt. of Assam and Guwagati University.
Attendance Rules
Student must attend atleast 75% of classes held during a session. Students attanding less than 75% of classes shall not be allowed to appear in the G.U. Examination as per guidelines of Guahati University.
Uniform
The student of the college must be in uniform in the college premises during the college hours and various occassions otherwise they will not be allowed to enter into the college premises.
For Boys :- Shirt (white), Longpant (Black)
For Girls :- Kamiz (white), Selowar and Dopatta (Black)
Benefit of the Student
Minority Scholarship, Ishan Uday Scholarship (UGC) if illigible (as per merit).
